E1 rear cheek over the servo: an MR128 seat M1 on each pivot
K1 keel under finger A's hubs, round the column socket S1 and strake slot S2
F1 front block, under the sectors, so that each gear passes over it
T1 tapped holes for the cap's M3 × 10s

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. One body serves both claws. Its socket on the Span Mount is ../900-ToolInterface/span_socket.scad's, shared with the Static Finger, and its layout along y is claw_params.scad's. It prints standing on its front face. The page opens cut on the roll axis's plane, through S1 and S2. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
